posts.hook: Riemann gets a second claimed proof, and Wall Street ends its worst tech week in six years
posts.caption: a second mathematician claimed a proof of the generalized riemann hypothesis, and alpöge's lean code was confirmed to state the right theorem. the nasdaq 100 lost 10.4% on the week, and the fbi is investigating an apparent breach of its criminal records database. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: A second GRH proof is claimed, and Alpöge's Lean code states the right theorem
slides.desc: If it compiles with no extra assumptions it is probably correct. No human may ==read it all==.

terms.gloss: a broader form of the riemann hypothesis, about how primes are spread
a language in which software checks every step of a math proof

slides.title: The Nasdaq 100 fell 5.6% Friday and ==10.4%== on the week
slides.desc: Its worst run in more than six years, on fears the AI spending boom is slowing.

slides.title: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of NCIC, sources tell CNN
slides.desc: Actual intrusions, unlike last week's outages. USDA's farm payment system was hit too.

terms.gloss: the fbi database police use to share warrants and background checks

slides.title: A ransomware recovery firm's CTO is charged: it just paid the hackers
slides.desc: Victims were billed a markup for decryption work never done, an FBI sting found.

slides.title: Cursor tells lawmakers it may phase out Chinese open-weight models
slides.desc: Its own Composer 2 is built on Kimi K2.5. Politics is reaching the base layer of coding tools.

terms.gloss: a chinese ai model whose weights anyone can download and build on

slides.title: The FCC orders California to stop holding AT&T to its landline duty
slides.desc: AT&T wants to cut basic phone service for 184,000 homes on June 1, 2027.
